verdict.rationale: Orama is a search/vector database and RAG data platform whose AI-facing integration is to expose its own data as an MCP *server* for other AI tools (ChatGPT, Cursor) to consume — the reverse of the story, which asks whether the product itself can plug in and use external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence Orama acts as an MCP client, and its product category (search infrastructure, not an agent) makes 'consuming other tools via MCP' a mismatched axis rather than a gap.
